turns.text: So, English would not only be useful, it would be necessary for me specifically.
turns.zh: 所以，英语对我来说不仅是有用的，而且是必需的。

turns.text: And in your future career, would you like to travel a lot or would you like to be in one location?
turns.zh: 那在你未来的职业中，你是想经常出差，还是想待在一个地方？

turns.text: I think when I have children, I will slow down the traveling a little bit just to have some structure and uh a feeling of groundedness in their lives, especially when they're younger.
turns.zh: 我想等我有了孩子，我会稍微减少一些旅行，就是为了让他们的生活有点规律，嗯，有一种安定的感觉，尤其是他们还小的时候。

turns.text: But up until then, in the near future, because I don't have any children at the moment, um I would love to travel as much as possible.
turns.zh: 但在那之前，在不久的将来，因为我现在还没有孩子，嗯，我会想尽可能多地旅行。

turns.text: So, a bit of both, I would say.
turns.zh: 所以，两者都有点吧，我会这么说。

turns.text: How do you think your life will change over the coming 5 to 10 years?
turns.zh: 你觉得在未来5到10年里，你的生活会怎样变化？

turns.text: I don't know about how it would change, but I know how I want it to change.
turns.zh: 我不知道它会怎样变化，但我知道我希望它怎样变化。
